author: lgmatias
body:
We're looking for 1 or 2 more people to add before invis. Only apply if you have played avicus before and like to play on avicus/pubs. I don't want you if you loath scrimming or playing minecraft in general.

As for the application, just write a paragraph on how you think your skills will benefit the team, and what they are. Spelling and grammar count. :/
